info.title: AI SiteMaker Runner API
info.description: Endpoints for launching, editing, and managing AI-generated marketing sites. All responses are JSON.

get.summary: Return a thumbnail URL for a site
get.description: Builds a thumbnail URL (via configured screenshot service) for the latest preview/public URL. Pass `refresh=true` to bust caches.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: When true, appends a cache-busting timestamp to the thumbnail URL.

get.description: Records a lightweight metric for a site slug (view or cta) and returns a 1x1 response.

post.description: Generates copy/layout with GPT-5.1, builds the base Vite template, and uploads the compiled /dist bundle to the preview bucket. Anonymous callers may launch once; authenticated users have an extra trial edit before a paid plan is required.

get.description: Returns the persisted site.json plus metadata describing the last deployment.

patch.summary: Apply edits to an existing site
patch.description: Loads the stored site.json, applies a structured patch or full replacement, rebuilds the Vite project, and redeploys to the existing preview prefix.

post.description: LLM-assisted editing flow. Sends the stored site + human instructions to GPT‑5.1 to produce a SitePatch, applies it, and redeploys the preview slug.

202.description: Instruction accepted and site redeploy queued

get.description: Returns objects stored under the site’s asset prefix.

post.description: Generates a pre-signed S3 PUT URL so clients can upload binary assets directly.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: File name returned by the list API. Do not include the full S3 prefix.

get.description: Returns a CDN URL with width/height/format parameters applied so the caller can fetch an optimized rendition.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: File name from the list API.

post.summary: Publish a draft update to the live prefix

201.description: Signup initiated. User must confirm via email.

SectionProps.description: Arbitrary props consumed by the section component.

componentId.description: One of the entries from SECTION_REGISTRY (e.g., hero-with-image, features-grid, testimonials-cards).

schemaMarkup.description: Optional JSON-LD string for schema.org markup.

sections.description: Single-page mode: ordered sections for the landing page. Provide either sections or pages.

pages.description: Multi-page mode: up to 5 pages, each with its own sections.

slug.description: Optional preferred slug. The system will append a counter if already taken.

regenerateImages.description: Set true to regenerate AI images; default is false to reuse existing assets.

instructions.description: Human-typed description of the desired changes. Example: "Move the gallery above testimonials and add a CTA button linking to /book."

assets.description: Optional manual asset context to include in the LLM prompt. Each entry should contain at least a url.

regenerateImages.description: Set true to regenerate AI images; default is false to reuse existing assets.

sourceUrl.description: Optional new reference site for context.

sendInvite.description: If false, suppresses the Cognito invite email.

temporaryPassword.description: Optional initial password. When provided with sendInvite=false it is set as a permanent password.
When supplied, sets a new permanent password in Cognito.
